image.status.none: @image: no image backend configured. Configure one (OPENAI_API_KEY, GOOGLEAI_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY, AWS credentials, CHATCLI_IMAGE_URL…) and pick it with @image use.
image.status.gen_only: generates only (edit needs a pinned edit backend: @image use with for=edit)
image.status.edit_pin: Edit backend when the active one cannot edit: %s, model %s
image.status.hint: List models with @image models; switch with @image use {provider, model}.
image.models.legend: Image models per backend. ✓ offered to your account now · · from the catalog (not checked) · ✗ not offered to your account. gen = text to image, edit = changes an input image.
image.models.live_failed: live listing failed, showing the catalog: %s
image.models.any_model: uses whatever model the server runs
image.use.edit_ok: @image edits now run on %s, model %s, whenever the active backend cannot edit.
image.use.persist: This lasts for the session. To keep it, set CHATCLI_IMAGE_PROVIDER and CHATCLI_IMAGE_MODEL (or CHATCLI_IMAGE_EDIT_PROVIDER/MODEL) in .env.
complete.configimage.edit: Backend (or model) used for edits when the active one cannot edit
